name: Rollin 60s Neighborhood Crips
description: The Rollin' 60s Neighborhood Crips are one of the largest Crip sets, founded in 1976 in Hyde Park, Los Angeles, from the Westside Crips. Named after West 60th Street running between Slauson and Florence Avenues, membership is estimated at approximately 1,600. Members identify by wearing Seattle Mariners and Chicago White Sox logos. Primary rivals are the Eight Tray Gangster Crips and Hoover Criminals; notable figures include Nipsey Hussle and Eugene 'Big U' Henley Jr., the latter arrested in 2025 on federal charges including kidnapping and murder.
